items.prompt: git blame on a file shows…
choices: Per line: last commit, author, and date that changed it
items.explain: Blame annotates each line with the most recent commit that modified it.

choices: Binary-search history for the first bad commit between good and bad tips
items.explain: Bisect halves the search range using your good/bad test until the first bad commit is found.

items.prompt: You should run git bisect reset when you are done bisecting.
items.explain: Reset leaves bisect mode and restores a normal checkout.

items.prompt: A good bisect test script should…
choices: Exit 0 for good revisions and non-zero for bad
items.explain: git bisect run uses exit status: 0 = good, non-zero = bad.
